# Knowledge Bridge

> A consulting firm specializing in equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI) strategy, organizational change, and sustainability for mission-driven organizations.

Knowledge Bridge, led by Irene Mosota, works with social enterprises, academic institutions, and cultural organizations across Africa, Asia, and Europe. The firm combines EDI implementation with change management and sustainability consulting to drive systemic organizational transformation.

## Key Topics

- Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI)
- Organizational Change Management
- Sustainability Strategy
- Values-Based Consulting
- Impact-Driven Organizations
- Social Enterprise Development
- Diversity & Inclusion Implementation
- Irene Mosota
- Giving Voice Initiative
- Black Academics & African Diaspora
- Change Leadership
- Mission-Values Alignment
- Consulting Services
- Team Leadership
